[[File:OmmniBox-SW.png|thumb|right|220px|An ommni box.]]

The '''ommni box''' was a notoriously hard-to-play instrument which enhanced [[Music/Legends|music]], and was commonly used in [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]]. It was usually used as an amplifier to attenuate and alter the bass aspects of the music, with such sophisticated parts as the [[Thwee pedal/Legends|thwee]] and [[Bwom pedal/Legends|bwom pedals]]. [[Tech Mo'r/Legends|Tech Mo'r]] played one for [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]'', Ommni Box is misspelled as omni box.
